description.label: Description
description.value:
Major Mental Mutation

The whites of one of your eyes turn blood red and elicit a deeply unnerving feeling from anyone you rest your gaze upon. You may inflict crippling pain upon someone you look at. If you succeed with an Opposed Willpower Test the target doubles up in pain and gains 1 @Condition[Fatigued] Condition and must pass a Hard (-20) Endurance Test or gain the @Condition[Prone] Condition. If you fail the Opposed Willpower Test you gain 1 @Condition[Stunned] Condition. You can only gain this mutation twice.
